page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with the running head at the top. No margin notes. Below the text: a signature at the right and a fleuron ornament, which is not transcribed.

main_text.p: credend.cap. 7. Una est Catholica Ecclesia, ait, cui hęreses alia diversa nomina imponunt, cùm ipsę singulę propriis vocabulis, quę negare nō audent, appellentur, & lib. Contra fundamétal. epistol. Manichęor.cap.4. Tenet, ait, me postre-mo ipsum Catholicę nomen, quod nō sine cau-sa inter tam multas hęreses sic ista Ecclesia sola obtinuit, ut cùm omnes hęretici sę Catholicos dicivelint, quęrenti tamen peregrino alicui, ubi ad Catholicam cōueniatur, nullus hęreticorum vel basilicam suam, vel domum audeat ostende-re. Est autem Catholica Ecclesia, quę Apostolorum doctrinę innititur, non hominum com-mentis, extra quam sunt omnes hęretici. Lactā-tius quoque his astipulatur lib. 4. Institut. Chri-stian. cap. ult. ubi etiam quę sit vera Ecclesia ostendit. Cùm enim, ait, Phryges aut Nouatiani, aut Valetiniani, aut Marcionitę, aut Anthropia-ni, seu quilibet alij nominantur, Christiani esse desierunt, qui Christi nomine amisso, humana & externa vocabula induxerunt. Sola igitur Catholica Ecclesia est, quę verum cultum retinet, &c. Sed ad Augustinum accedamus.

page.notes: Lines beginning "credend.cap. 7." and "epistol.Manichęor.cap.4." are small reference phrases set inside the column; they are transcribed in place. Doubtful: "fundamétal" (the accent may be an ornament; read as fundamental), "sę" (the abbreviation may be se), "ult." (read as ult.). The text is faint at the left edge and some letters near the margin are hard to make out. Show-through from the reverse side is ignored.
